annotations.title: Plan how much tax to set aside

description: Plan how much to set aside for tax as a sole trader under Making Tax Digital, from the year's profit or each quarter's profit: the income tax, Class 4 National Insurance and student loan due, monthly and weekly amounts to put away, running totals by quarter with each update deadline, and any first payment on account.

annualProfit.description: Expected profit for the year (split evenly across quarters)

firstYearOfTrading.description: True in the first year, when the first payment on account is also due

quarterlyProfits.description: Profit for each quarter, Q1 to Q4, instead of an annual figure

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plans held: one plan or a list of every plan, e.g. ["plan2", "postgrad"]. plan1 (pre-2012), plan2 (2012 onwards), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (2023 onwards), postgrad (postgraduate loan, repaid alongside any other plan). Omit or "none" for no loan.

name: plan_quarterly_tax_set_aside
title: Plan how much tax to set aside
